basis: Skin/skeletal overgrowth define syndrome; intellectual disability 80-99%, cataract/retinal detachment 30-79%. Vascular involvement 30-79% omitted at cap; parathyroid dysfunction unspecified.

decisions.neurologic: involved: intellectual disability occurs in 80-99% and hydrocephalus in 30-79%; these accompany the defining skin and skeletal overgrowth.

basis: Structural skeletal myopathy; strabismus 30-79% does not establish direct eye damage. Respiratory insufficiency reflects respiratory muscle weakness, not pulmonary disease.

decisions.ocular: none: strabismus is reported in 30-79%, but extraocular muscle dysfunction does not establish direct eye damage; ophthalmoplegia occurs in only 5-29%.

basis: Facial muscle hypoplasia defines disease. HPO places renal malformations, cortical atrophy and cleft palate/tooth agenesis at 30-79% each. Cardiac defects occur in 5-29%.

decisions.renal: involved: renal hypoplasia/aplasia, multiple renal cysts and vesicoureteral reflux are each annotated at 30-79%; supplied frequencies support structural urinary involvement.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: cleft palate and tooth agenesis are each annotated at 30-79%; both are structural defects within the gastrointestinal axis.
decisions.neurologic: involved: cerebral cortical atrophy is annotated at 30-79%, providing direct structural neurologic involvement beyond microcephaly alone.

basis: Disease arises in the levator ani skeletal muscle; rectal pain reflects muscle spasm without established disease of the rectum or anal mucosa.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: rectal pain is produced by levator ani muscle spasm; the definition establishes no independent rectal or anal tissue dysfunction.

basis: Ichthyosis/alopecia, intellectual disability and eyelid ectropion define syndrome. Eclabion at 30-79% reflects cutaneous contracture without established oral mucosal damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: eclabion occurs in 30-79% but represents lip eversion from skin contracture; direct gastrointestinal tissue damage or loss of function is not established.

basis: Irreversible fibrosing bronchiolar obstruction defines disease; the predominant chronic lung-allograft form involves alloimmune injury. Associated infections are separate diseases.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: the definition identifies chronic lung-allograft dysfunction as the predominant setting, supporting alloimmune disease across most cases despite non-transplant forms.

basis: Defined by peripheral vascular injury attributable to diabetes; the underlying diabetes is a separately diagnosed metabolic disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: this concept denotes vascular damage, not an endocrine gland lesion or metabolic disorder itself; diabetes is the underlying separate disease.

basis: Cutaneous lichen encompasses predominantly immune-mediated lichenoid disease, including lichen planus. Genital skin remains dermatologic; common damaging oral involvement is unproven.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: immune-mediated cutaneous inflammation characterizes the major lichenoid forms, particularly lichen planus; an identified autoantigen is not required.

basis: Disordered central respiratory signaling defines disease; apnea does not establish intrinsic lung or airway disease. Cardiovascular consequences are later risks.

decisions.pulmonary: none: ventilation stops because central respiratory drive fails; the definition establishes no intrinsic lung or airway disorder or direct pulmonary damage.

basis: Myeloid leukemia with coagulopathy; leukemic skin infiltration occurs in roughly 30-40%. Hepatic infiltration reaching 30% across ages is not established by hepatomegaly alone.

decisions.hepatic: none: hepatomegaly is described, but direct hepatic infiltration in at least 30% across the disease population is uncertain and varies with age.
decisions.dermatologic: involved: direct leukemic skin infiltration occurs in approximately 30-40%, meeting the threshold for substantial organ occupation.
